capabilities: suggest MathJax commands with rendered previews while typing
insert snippets with tab-stop fields navigable via Tab
auto-insert braces for subscripts and superscripts
indent environments and align & columns without changing rendered output
browse, customize and back up about 1,260 built-in symbols
disambiguation: Does not change how math is rendered; it adds typing assistance such as autocomplete, snippets and formatting.
extras: Version 2.0 changes some command IDs, so users upgrading from 1.x must reassign three hotkeys; full feature screenshots are in a separate Features page.
intentEvidence: Better MathJax suggests MathJax commands and environments while you type math in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian offers no autocomplete, snippet expansion or formatting assistance while typing LaTeX math in $...$ and $$...$$ blocks.

relations.evidence: Symbol data: MathJax TeX syntax reference (CC 2.5)

summary: Math autocomplete plugin that suggests MathJax commands and environments while typing, with tab-stop snippets, auto-braces and customizable symbols.
